description: This Java class 'MongoReadJournal' provides methods to interact with MongoDB for reading event journals and snapshots in an Akka-based persistence system. It includes functions for retrieving persistence IDs, latest snapshots, and managing MongoDB aggregation pipelines, with configuration handling for collection names and auto-start settings.

classes.name: MongoReadJournal
classes.description: Provides methods to read event journals and snapshots from MongoDB, including retrieval of persistence IDs and latest snapshots, with configuration handling and aggregation pipelines.

classes.name: SnapshotBatch
classes.description: Encapsulates a batch of snapshot documents with a maximum PID identifier.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MongoReadJournal instance based on ActorSystem configuration.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MongoReadJournal instance with specified collection names and MongoClient, mainly for testing.

methods.name: getJournalPids
methods.description: Retrieves all unique persistence IDs from the journal, with batching and backoff.

methods.name: getJournalPidsAbove
methods.description: Retrieves persistence IDs above a specified lower bound.

methods.name: getNewestSnapshotsAbove
methods.description: Retrieves the latest snapshots with PIDs above a specified lower bound.
